A000320.bio: Joel Funk Asper was a Republican U.S. Representative for Missouri's 7th congressional district (1869–1871). Asper worked as a lawyer, served in the U.S. Army and was a veteran of the Civil War.

A000321.name: James Benjamin Aswell
A000321.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000321.bio: James Benjamin Aswell was a Democratic U.S. Representative for Louisiana's 8th congressional district (1913–1931). Aswell worked as a lawyer. Aswell died in office in 1931.

A000322.name: David Rice Atchison
A000322.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000322.bio: David Rice Atchison was a Democratic U.S. Senator from Missouri (1843–1855). Atchison also served as President pro tempore of the Senate. Atchison worked as a lawyer and judge, served in the U.S. Army and was a veteran of the Civil War.

A000323.name: Charles G. Atherton
A000323.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000323.bio: Charles G. Atherton was a Democratic politician from New Hampshire who served as U.S. Representative (1837–1843) and U.S. Senator (1843–1849, 1853). Atherton worked as a lawyer. Atherton died in office in 1853.

A000324.name: Charles Humphrey Atherton
A000324.bio: Charles Humphrey Atherton was a Federalist at-large U.S. Representative from New Hampshire (1815–1817). Atherton worked as a lawyer.

A000325.name: Gibson Atherton
A000325.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000325.bio: Gibson Atherton was a Democratic U.S. Representative from Ohio (1879–1883). Atherton worked as a lawyer and judge.

A000326.name: William O. Atkeson
A000326.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000326.bio: William O. Atkeson was a Republican U.S. Representative for Missouri's 6th congressional district (1921–1923). Atkeson worked as a lawyer and journalist.

A000327.name: John D. C. Atkins
A000327.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000327.bio: John D. C. Atkins was a Democratic U.S. Representative from Tennessee (1857–1859, 1873–1883). Atkins worked as a lawyer.

A000328.name: Archibald Atkinson
A000328.bio: Archibald Atkinson was a Democratic U.S. Representative for Virginia's 1st congressional district (1843–1849). Atkinson worked as a lawyer and was a veteran of the War of 1812.

A000329.name: Eugene Atkinson
A000329.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000329.bio: Eugene Atkinson was a U.S. Representative for Pennsylvania's 25th congressional district (1979–1983), changing party over time (Democrat, then Republican).

A000330.name: George W. Atkinson
A000330.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000330.bio: George W. Atkinson was a Republican politician from West Virginia who served as U.S. Representative (1890–1891) and Governor of West Virginia (1897–1901). Atkinson worked as a lawyer and judge.

A000331.name: Louis E. Atkinson
A000331.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000331.bio: Louis E. Atkinson was a Republican U.S. Representative for Pennsylvania's 18th congressional district (1883–1893). Atkinson worked as a lawyer and physician, served in the U.S. Army and was a veteran of the Civil War.

A000332.name: Richard Merrill Atkinson
A000332.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000332.bio: Richard Merrill Atkinson was a Democratic U.S. Representative for Tennessee's 5th congressional district (1937–1939). Atkinson worked as a lawyer, served in the U.S. Marine Corps and was a veteran of World War I.

A000334.name: John W. Atwater
A000334.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000334.bio: John W. Atwater was a Populist U.S. Representative for North Carolina's 4th congressional district (1899–1901).

A000335.name: David Atwood
A000335.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000335.bio: David Atwood was a Republican U.S. Representative for Wisconsin's 2nd congressional district (1870–1871). Atwood worked as a journalist.

A000336.name: Harrison H. Atwood
A000336.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000336.bio: Harrison H. Atwood was a Republican U.S. Representative for Massachusetts's 10th congressional district (1895–1897).

A000337.name: Les AuCoin
A000337.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000337.bio: Les AuCoin was a Democratic U.S. Representative for Oregon's 1st congressional district (1975–1993). AuCoin worked as a journalist and educator and served in the U.S. Army.

A000338.name: Oscar L. Auf der Heide
A000338.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000338.bio: Oscar L. Auf der Heide was a Democratic U.S. Representative from New Jersey (1925–1935).

A000339.name: Albert E. Austin
A000339.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000339.bio: Albert E. Austin was a Republican U.S. Representative for Connecticut's 4th congressional district (1939–1941). Austin served in the U.S. Army and was a veteran of World War I.

A000340.name: Archibald Austin
A000340.bio: Archibald Austin was a Democratic-Republican U.S. Representative for Virginia's 16th congressional district (1817–1819). Austin worked as a lawyer.

A000341.name: Richard W. Austin
A000341.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000341.bio: Richard W. Austin was a Republican U.S. Representative for Tennessee's 2nd congressional district (1909–1919). Austin worked as a lawyer and diplomat.

A000342.name: Warren Austin
A000342.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000342.bio: Warren Austin was a Republican U.S. Senator from Vermont (1931–1946). Austin also served as U.S. Ambassador to the United Nations (1947–1953) and a party leader in Congress. Austin worked as a lawyer and judge.

A000343.name: Thomas H. Averett
A000343.bio: Thomas H. Averett was a Democratic U.S. Representative for Virginia's 3rd congressional district (1849–1853). Averett served in the U.S. Army and was a veteran of the War of 1812.

A000344.name: John T. Averill
A000344.bio: John T. Averill was a Republican U.S. Representative from Minnesota (1871–1875). Averill worked as a businessperson, served in the U.S. Army and was a veteran of the Civil War.

A000345.name: Daniel Avery
A000345.bio: Daniel Avery was a Democratic-Republican U.S. Representative from New York (1811–1815, 1816–1817).

A000346.name: John Avery
A000346.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000346.bio: John Avery was a Republican U.S. Representative for Michigan's 11th congressional district (1893–1897). Avery worked as a physician, served in the U.S. Army and was a veteran of the Civil War.

A000347.name: William T. Avery
A000347.bio: William T. Avery was a Democratic U.S. Representative for Tennessee's 10th congressional district (1857–1861). Avery worked as a lawyer.

A000348.name: Samuel B. Avis
A000348.photoCredit: Biographical Publishing Company (Chicago, IL), publisher., Public domain
A000348.bio: Samuel B. Avis was a Republican U.S. Representative for West Virginia's 3rd congressional district (1913–1915). Avis worked as a lawyer and was a veteran of the Spanish–American War.

A000349.name: Samuel Beach Axtell
A000349.bio: Samuel Beach Axtell was a Democratic politician who served as U.S. Representative from California (1867–1871), territorial Governor of Utah (1875) and territorial Governor of New Mexico (1875–1878). Axtell worked as a lawyer and judge.

A000350.name: John Bancker Aycrigg
A000350.bio: John Bancker Aycrigg was a Whig at-large U.S. Representative from New Jersey (1837–1839, 1841–1843).

A000351.name: Richard S. Ayer
A000351.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000351.bio: Richard S. Ayer was a Republican U.S. Representative for Virginia's 1st congressional district (1870–1871). Ayer served in the U.S. Army and was a veteran of the Civil War.

A000352.name: Roy E. Ayers
A000352.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000352.bio: Roy E. Ayers was a Democratic politician from Montana who served as U.S. Representative (1933–1937) and Governor of Montana (1937–1941). Ayers worked as a lawyer and judge.

A000353.name: Steven Beckwith Ayres
A000353.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000353.bio: Steven Beckwith Ayres was a Democratic U.S. Representative for New York's 18th congressional district (1911–1913).

A000354.name: William Augustus Ayres
A000354.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000354.bio: William Augustus Ayres was a Democratic U.S. Representative from Kansas (1915–1921, 1923–1934). Ayres worked as a lawyer.

A000355.name: Spencer Abraham
A000355.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000355.bio: Spencer Abraham was a Republican U.S. Senator from Michigan (1995–2001). Abraham also served as Secretary of Energy (2001–2005). Abraham worked as a lawyer and businessperson.

A000356.name: John Ashcroft
A000356.photoCredit: United States Department of Justice, Public domain
A000356.bio: John Ashcroft was a Republican politician from Missouri who served as Governor of Missouri (1985–1993) and U.S. Senator (1995–2001). Ashcroft also served as Attorney General (2001–2005). Ashcroft worked as a lawyer and educator.

A000357.name: Tom Allen
A000357.photoCredit: U.S. Government Publishing Office / unitedstates project, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000357.bio: Tom Allen was a Democratic U.S. Representative for Maine's 1st congressional district (1997–2009). Allen worked as a lawyer.

A000358.name: W. Todd Akin
A000358.photoCredit: U.S. Government Publishing Office / unitedstates project, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000358.bio: W. Todd Akin was a Republican U.S. Representative for Missouri's 2nd congressional district (2001–2013). Akin served in the U.S. Army.

A000359.name: Aníbal Acevedo Vilá
A000359.photoCredit: Biographical Directory of the United States Congress, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000359.bio: Aníbal Acevedo Vilá was a Popular Democratic politician from Puerto Rico who served as Resident Commissioner (2001–2005) and Governor of Puerto Rico (2005–2009). Acevedo-Vilá worked as a lawyer.

A000360.name: Lamar Alexander
A000360.photoCredit: U.S. Government Publishing Office / unitedstates project, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000360.bio: Lamar Alexander was a Republican politician from Tennessee who served as Governor of Tennessee (1979–1987) and U.S. Senator (2003–2021). Alexander also served as Secretary of Education (1991–1993). Alexander worked as a lawyer and educator.

A000361.name: Rodney Alexander
A000361.photoCredit: U.S. Government Publishing Office / unitedstates project, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000361.bio: Rodney Alexander was a U.S. Representative for Louisiana's 5th congressional district (2003–2013), changing party over time (Democrat, then Republican). Alexander worked as a businessperson and served in the U.S. Air Force.

A000362.name: Jason Altmire
A000362.photoCredit: U.S. Government Publishing Office / unitedstates project, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000362.bio: Jason Altmire was a Democratic U.S. Representative for Pennsylvania's 4th congressional district (2007–2013). Altmire worked as a lawyer and athlete.

A000363.name: Mike Arcuri
A000363.photoCredit: U.S. Government Publishing Office / unitedstates project, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000363.bio: Mike Arcuri was a Democratic U.S. Representative for New York's 24th congressional district (2007–2011). Arcuri worked as a lawyer and educator.

A000364.name: John Adler
A000364.photoCredit: U.S. Government Publishing Office / unitedstates project, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000364.bio: John Adler was a Democratic U.S. Representative for New Jersey's 3rd congressional district (2009–2011). Adler worked as a lawyer.

A000365.name: Steve Austria
A000365.photoCredit: U.S. Government Publishing Office / unitedstates project, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000365.bio: Steve Austria was a Republican U.S. Representative for Ohio's 7th congressional district (2009–2013).

A000366.name: Sandy Adams
A000366.photoCredit: U.S. Government Publishing Office / unitedstates project, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000366.bio: Sandy Adams was a Republican U.S. Representative for Florida's 24th congressional district (2011–2013). Adams served in the U.S. Air Force.

A000367.name: Justin Amash
A000367.photoCredit: U.S. Government Publishing Office / unitedstates project, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000367.bio: Justin Amash was a U.S. Representative for Michigan's 3rd congressional district (2011–2021), changing party over time (Republican, then Independent, then Libertarian). Amash worked as a lawyer.

A000368.name: Kelly Ayotte
A000368.photoCredit: U.S. Government Publishing Office / unitedstates project, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000368.bio: Kelly Ayotte is a Republican politician from New Hampshire who has served as U.S. Senator (2011–2017) and Governor of New Hampshire (since 2025). Ayotte worked as a lawyer.

A000369.name: Mark E. Amodei
A000369.photoCredit: U.S. Government Publishing Office / unitedstates project, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000369.bio: Mark E. Amodei is a Republican U.S. Representative for Nevada's 2nd congressional district, in office since 2011. Amodei worked as a lawyer and judge and served in the U.S. Army.

A000370.name: Alma S. Adams
A000370.photoCredit: U.S. Government Publishing Office / unitedstates project, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000370.bio: Alma S. Adams is a Democratic U.S. Representative for North Carolina's 12th congressional district, in office since 2014. Adams worked as an educator.

A000371.name: Pete Aguilar
A000371.photoCredit: U.S. Government Publishing Office / unitedstates project, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000371.bio: Pete Aguilar is a Democratic U.S. Representative from California, in office since 2015. Aguilar worked as a businessperson.

A000372.name: Rick W. Allen
A000372.photoCredit: U.S. Government Publishing Office / unitedstates project, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000372.bio: Rick W. Allen is a Republican U.S. Representative for Georgia's 12th congressional district, in office since 2015. Allen worked as a businessperson.

A000373.name: Brad Ashford
A000373.photoCredit: U.S. Government Publishing Office / unitedstates project, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000373.bio: Brad Ashford was a Democratic U.S. Representative for Nebraska's 2nd congressional district (2015–2017). Ashford worked as a lawyer and businessperson.

A000374.name: Ralph Lee Abraham
A000374.photoCredit: U.S. Government Publishing Office / unitedstates project, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000374.bio: Ralph Lee Abraham was a Republican U.S. Representative for Louisiana's 5th congressional district (2015–2021). Abraham served in the U.S. Army.

A000375.name: Jodey C. Arrington
A000375.photoCredit: U.S. Government Publishing Office / unitedstates project, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000375.bio: Jodey C. Arrington is a Republican U.S. Representative for Texas's 19th congressional district, in office since 2017. Arrington worked as a businessperson.

A000376.name: Colin Z. Allred
A000376.photoCredit: U.S. Government Publishing Office / unitedstates project, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000376.bio: Colin Z. Allred was a Democratic U.S. Representative for Texas's 32nd congressional district (2019–2025). Allred was elected in 2026 as a Democratic U.S. Representative for Texas's 33rd congressional district, taking office on January 3, 2027. Allred worked as a lawyer and athlete.

A000377.name: Kelly Armstrong
A000377.photoCredit: U.S. Government Publishing Office / unitedstates project, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000377.bio: Kelly Armstrong is a Republican politician from North Dakota who has served as U.S. Representative (2019–2024) and Governor of North Dakota (since 2024).

A000378.name: Cynthia Axne
A000378.photoCredit: U.S. Government Publishing Office / unitedstates project, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000378.bio: Cynthia Axne was a Democratic U.S. Representative for Iowa's 3rd congressional district (2019–2023).

A000379.name: Mark Alford
A000379.photoCredit: U.S. Government Publishing Office / unitedstates project, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000379.bio: Mark Alford is a Republican U.S. Representative for Missouri's 4th congressional district, in office since 2023. Alford worked as a journalist.

A000380.name: Gabe Amo
A000380.photoCredit: U.S. Government Publishing Office / unitedstates project, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000380.bio: Gabe Amo is a Democratic U.S. Representative for Rhode Island's 1st congressional district, in office since 2023.

A000381.name: Yassamin Ansari
A000381.photoCredit: U.S. Government Publishing Office / unitedstates project, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000381.bio: Yassamin Ansari is a Democratic U.S. Representative for Arizona's 3rd congressional district, in office since 2025.

A000382.name: Angela D. Alsobrooks
A000382.photoCredit: U.S. Government Publishing Office / unitedstates project, Public domain (U.S. government work)
A000382.bio: Angela D. Alsobrooks is a Democratic U.S. Senator from Maryland, in office since 2025. Alsobrooks worked as a lawyer.

A000383.name: Alan Armstrong
A000383.bio: Alan Armstrong is a Republican U.S. Senator from Oklahoma, in office since 2026. Armstrong worked as a businessperson and engineer.
